sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Deal magic damage (Star) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only). [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Increases Fire, Water, Wind, Light, Dark, Time, and Star elemental attack by 20 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack buff limit by 10 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Success value 30. Nullifies physical damage taken for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Success value 30. Nullifies magic damage taken for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Concerto for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 4. If Concerto is applied to allies as well, status ailments, debuffs, Cost reduction, and Unison gauge reduction will also be nullified based on the number of members (excluding self) in Concerto state).
-Applies Savior Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 6, and increases Cost recovery speed by 10) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000
Lethargy and Frail Resistance Up by 60
Time and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 150 seconds.

[Duet] D. Symphony x Kasumi Yoshizawa or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
